laws.rule: Since 1 April 2026 Hokkaido charges an accommodation tax per person per night: JPY 100 under JPY 20,000, JPY 200 from JPY 20,000 to 49,999, JPY 500 from JPY 50,000 (about A$0.90 to about A$4.51, RBA rate of 30 October 2026). Sapporo, Otaru, Niseko, Kutchan, Hakodate, Furano and other towns add their own tax on top (Kutchan charges a flat 3% including the prefectural share). Paid to the accommodation.
laws.heading: 北海道宿泊税 (Hokkaido Accommodation Tax)

laws.rule: In Kutchan Town (Niseko Hirafu area), from stays on 1 April 2026 the accommodation tax is a single 3% of the room rate a person a night, which includes the Hokkaido accommodation tax; the town collects both. Stays to 31 March 2026 were 2%.
laws.heading: 倶知安町宿泊税条例 (amended June 2025)

laws.rule: Hokkaido Youth Healthy Development Ordinance (北海道青少年健全育成条例), art. 35 (guardian) and 35(3) (others). The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to 4 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 100,000 (about A$902) or a petty fine (kayo). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.
laws.heading: 北海道青少年健全育成条例 (Hokkaido), curfew for young people

laws.rule: In Sapporo City, the anti-littering ordinance prohibits discarding cigarette ends, cans and other litter throughout the city, and requires people to pick up their dog’s droppings in public places.
laws.heading: Sapporo littering and smoking ordinance guidance

laws.rule: In Sapporo City’s designated smoking-restriction areas, the ordinance prohibits smoking while walking or away from a nearby ashtray in public places. The city says heated tobacco is outside this smoking penalty, although littering its cartridges remains prohibited.

layers.authority: Shiretoko Five Lakes Field House (Ministry of the Environment use-adjustment zone)
layers.process: Ground trail around the Five Lakes, bear activity period 10 May to 31 July: walking needs a guided tour with a registered Five Lakes guide. Tours cost about JPY 6,000 (adults, big loop, advance booking from) or JPY 4,000 (small loop); same-day JPY 7,000 and JPY 4,000; children 6 to 11 about half; about A$54 and A$36 for advance adults (RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82). The trail is closed when a brown bear appears.
activities: walking the Five Lakes ground trail

layers.authority: Shiretoko Five Lakes Field House (Ministry of the Environment use-adjustment zone)
layers.process: Vegetation protection periods (opening to 9 May, and 1 August to closing): no guide needed, but entry needs a short on-site lecture (about 10 minutes, 50 people a session) and an entry application at the Field House. Fee JPY 450 adult, JPY 200 child aged 0 to 11 (about A$4.06 and A$1.80). Groups of 15 or more should phone ahead. The elevated wooden path is free and needs no registration.
